item.description:
Investor Services – Associate 2 at State Street in Singapore matches Théo's profile: location fits, role aligns with IR/support/product, English is the working language, no Chinese/Japanese/Korean required, and experience requirements are not explicitly exceeding 3 years. Strong compatibility with his job search criteria. Job Summary To support the end-to-end delivery of Investor Services by processing investor onboarding and lifecycle activities accurately, in accordance with fund governing documents and internal controls requirements. The role provides timely and responsive service to clients and investors while maintaining complete records and escalating exceptions appropriately.
Job Duties and Responsibilities · Process investor activities accurately and within agreed deadlines, including subscriptions or commitments, capital calls, distributions, redemptions where applicable, transfers and investor detail changes. · Review investor instructions and supporting documentation for completeness, authorised signatures, fund eligibility, notice requirements and compliance with fund governing documents and procedures. · Set up and maintain investor, commitment and transaction data in the relevant investor servicing systems, ensuring records are complete and accurate. · Prepare and issue investor communications and transaction documents, including acknowledgements, capital call notices, distribution notices, contract notes, statements and other periodic reports. · Support fund closings and subsequent closings, including the processing of new or increased commitments and coordination of related investor documentation. · Maintain investor capital activity records and support the reconciliation of commitments, contributions, distributions and outstanding balances with Fund Accountin

item.title: [C] KYC Solutions & Change Intern - YTP program — Deutsche Bank
item.description:
Offre d'internat KYC Solutions & Change (Deutsche Bank, Singapour) dans le cadre du programme YTP. Fonction junior mais orientée KYC, transformation, process intelligence et AI, éloignée des cibles de Théo en ventes/distribution, relations investisseurs, produit ou service client dans la gestion d'actifs, la banque privée ou le private equity. Job Description: The intern will support KYC transformation, process intelligence, and AI-enabled change initiatives within KYC Operations. Responsibilities include documenting business processes and requirements, supporting AI and automation use cases, analysing operational data, assisting with process mining and workflow analysis, validating AI outputs, preparing management information and insights, and supporting the design and testing of solutions that improve client onboarding, regulatory compliance, operational efficiency, and risk management. The role provides exposure to AI applications in KYC, customer onboarding, regulatory compliance, process optimisation, data analysis, and change delivery within a global banking environment.
We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively. Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.
We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.
